subject: Day 3: Whistleblower Transcript
instructionString:
Editor-in-Chief,

Format the raw whistleblower transcript immediately.

1. Center-align and Bold the Title: 'INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT: PROJECT MAINTENANCE FUEL'.
2. Bold the Interviewer Questions (Left-aligned).
3. Keep Witness Responses Left-aligned body text.

- Mrs. Santos

startingTextBlocks.text: Q1: Did you see the administration moving gasoline behind the gym?
WITNESS: I saw it. Late at night, behind the gym. They were using the school budget for 'maintenance,' but that fuel wasn't for the mowers. It was for their personal cars.
Q2: Can you confirm who was driving the vehicles?
WITNESS: High-ranking staff. They took full canisters straight from the supply shed.
